tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground: warm poster paper (dark: the club after hours).

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, source records, liner notes. Sits on paper.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between ledger rows. Decorative only, never a control border.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders. 3:1 or more on paper and paper-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The black ink: body text and headlines on paper, paper-raised and red-soft; the W of the monograms; the cut bars. Never on ochre: in the dark theme it turns paper-coloured and falls to 1.5:1 there; use on-ochre.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, italic labels, metadata on paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: First ink: the primary button, slogans set large, the big sheet of the cover. As text only at 24px and up; smaller red text uses red-ink.

tokens.name: red-ink
tokens.usage: Red text under 24px (refused badge, inline warnings) on paper, paper-raised or red-soft.

tokens.name: red-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind red-ink text: red printed at a light screen.

tokens.name: on-red
tokens.usage: Text and marks on a red fill. Never literal white.

tokens.name: ochre
tokens.usage: Third ink, the mustard of a jazz sleeve: cut bars, the pending badge, the quiet button's underline. Fill only, never text on paper.

tokens.name: on-ochre
tokens.usage: Text and marks on an ochre fill, in both themes (7.8:1 light, 9.9:1 dark). The only ink allowed on ochre.

styles.name: poster
styles.usage: The one slogan at the top of a page and the name on a cover. 56px and up only, never for anything people must read to act.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: A Slogan component. 56px and up only.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: An LLM you can rebuild end to end.
styles.usage: The first paragraph under a headline.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every source is pinned with its address, revision and checksum.

styles.name: aside
styles.usage: Kickers and labels, lowercase italic, at most a few words. Never a full sentence in italics.

styles.name: ledger
styles.usage: Licenses, checksums, revisions, paths: values only, never paragraphs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside badges; between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between buttons and badges.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section; cover insets.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections, and the silences around a slogan.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything cut: buttons, badges, bars, cards take an irregular clip instead of a radius.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Inputs only.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Discs only (a cut-paper circle on a poster).

tokens.name: shadow-misprint
tokens.usage: A sheet lifted off the wall: hover on buttons and source cards. No soft shadows.

tokens.name: tilt-1
tokens.usage: Badges and tape: pasted slightly crooked. Never on text longer than two words.

tokens.name: tilt-2
tokens.usage: Cut bars and tape only; text is never rotated beyond tilt-1.

tokens.name: tilt-3
tokens.usage: Cut bars in a composition.
